records.title: CDC import path depends on recent rabies-risk travel
records.rule_text: Determine whether the dog has been in a CDC high-risk country for dog rabies during the 6 months before U.S. entry before selecting the documentation path.
records.source_authority: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

records.title: CDC Dog Import Form
records.rule_text: Complete a CDC Dog Import Form for each dog. CDC states this is the only CDC form needed when the dog has only been in dog-rabies-free or low-risk countries during the 6 months before U.S. entry.
records.source_authority: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

records.title: EU animal health certificate
records.rule_text: For non-commercial entry from a non-EU country, an animal health certificate is generally required unless an applicable pet-passport exception applies.

records.title: Primary rabies vaccination waiting period
records.rule_text: After the first rabies vaccination or completion of the primary course, wait at least 21 full days before travel to Great Britain.

records.title: Dog tapeworm treatment window
records.rule_text: Where the tapeworm rule applies, treatment must be given no less than 24 hours and no more than 5 days before arrival in Great Britain.

records.title: Great Britain pet health certificate entry window
records.rule_text: When using a Great Britain pet health certificate, the pet must enter Great Britain within 10 days of the certificate being issued.

records.title: USA-origin New World screwworm inspection document
records.rule_text: For a dog arriving from the United States, current SENASICA guidance requires an inspection document confirming freedom from New World screwworm, signed by a USDA-accredited veterinarian within the 5 days before travel.

records.title: Internal and external parasite treatment
records.rule_text: SENASA states dogs and cats must be treated for internal and external parasites within 15 days before arrival, with treatment details included in the official certificate.

records.title: Official sanitary certificate
records.rule_text: ICA requires an original sanitary certificate issued or endorsed by the official sanitary authority of the origin country no more than 10 calendar days before entry.

records.title: Official Zoosanitary Export Certificate
records.rule_text: Agrocalidad requires an official Zoosanitary Export Certificate from the origin country's veterinary authority, in Spanish or English, meeting Ecuador's sanitary requirements.

records.title: Cargo arrival import permit workflow
records.rule_text: For a dog or cat arriving in cargo, Agrocalidad requires a Zoosanitary Import Permit workflow and specifies advance document handling 72 hours before arrival.
